translations.source: Lake Pipes, a division of Lake Group established in 2019, manufactures and distributes quality PVC and HDPE pipes, water tanks and fittings for water system management, irrigation systems, water distribution systems and sewage disposal systems.
translations.translation: Lake Pipes 是 Lake Group 于 2019 年成立的业务部门，生产和分销优质 PVC 与 HDPE 管道、水箱及管件，用于水系统管理、灌溉、供水和污水处理系统。

translations.source: The manufacturing plant at Visiga, Kibaha, Tanzania, is equipped with ultramodern PVC, PPR and HDPE multilayer extruders, roto molding and blow molding machines. Products are quality tested at every stage to maintain standards.
translations.translation: 坦桑尼亚 Kibaha 的 Visiga 制造厂配备了先进的 PVC、PPR 和 HDPE 多层挤出机，以及滚塑和吹塑设备。产品在每个阶段都经过质量检测，以维持标准。
